versions.content: MULTIPLEFEATURE One or more of the FMFeature s ref- erenced in the role feature from a FMFeatureDecomposition that has the category MULTIPLEFEATURE shall be present in a feature selection if and only if its parent FMFeature is included in the feature selection. This is fur- ther constrained by the attributes min and max (see [TPS_FMDT_00012] and [constr_5013]).
